segments.headline: YOUR AI AGENT JUST FAILED
segments.body: Do you have a recovery plan?
segments.spoken: Your AI agent just failed during a live business workflow. What happens next? Run this three-step recovery drill before a real incident.

segments.headline: STOP THE ACTIONS
segments.body: Pause tool access. Revoke risky permissions.
segments.spoken: First, stop further actions. Pause the workflow and remove risky tool permissions. A prompt telling an agent to stop is not a reliable emergency switch.

segments.headline: REBUILD THE TIMELINE
segments.body: Capture tool calls, inputs, outputs and approvals.
segments.spoken: Second, reconstruct the timeline. Preserve the inputs, tool calls, outputs and human approvals. Identify the first unsafe action, not only the final error.

segments.headline: RESTORE SAFELY
segments.body: Use a known-good state. Test before restart.
segments.spoken: Third, restore a known-good state. Test the corrected workflow in a safe environment, then approve a controlled restart.

segments.headline: MEASURE RECOVERY TIME
segments.spoken: Record how long detection, containment and restoration took. Repeat the drill after major changes. This is a practical management exercise, not a legal standard.

segments.headline: BUILD AGENTS YOU CAN CONTROL
